label: copy phase: input 3 or e while outputting e (recall_idx >= 3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original or delimiter phases), and only when the fed-back input is 3 (79% of mass) or e (21%); essentially nothing on other inputs. Strongest when the input is 3 and the token being output is e (the pattern ...3 e... in the original); top examples are all 3 followed by e e, with the 3 step near max and the following e step at roughly 0.1-0.5 of max. out_tok == e carries 86% of mass. Rare before recall_idx 3, and the rate rises toward the end of the sequence. Missed activations are mostly weak firings on input 3 with outputs other than e (z, h, j, etc.), typically under 0.25 of max. False positives are mostly input e (often the first e of an e e pair) outputting e where the feature stays silent, and the reason is not clear. Never fires on the first occurrence of a token (in_first = 0 for every activation).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=3 (+8.24), phase=2 & in_tok=e (+5.58), next_out=e (+4.61), phase=2 & out_tok=e (+4.24), out_tok=e (+3.86), in_tok=3 (+3.67). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-3.13), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.13), next_out=i (-2.10), to_go=5 (-2.02).
